en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Mansour Bin Yunus, from Abu Hamza Al Sumaly, 
(It has been narrated) from Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Do not be deceived by the embrace of the two arms with the blood, for it, in the Presence of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic is a killer who does not die’. They said, ‘O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>! And what is the killer who does not die?’ So he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The Fire (of Hell)’.
